item.punizioni.executioner_hood.desc1: Black, two holes for the eyes: the executioner has no face and no name.
item.punizioni.executioner_hood.desc2: Hides the name over your head.
item.punizioni.executioner_apron.desc1: Thick leather, stained with old blood. With studded bracers.
item.punizioni.cat_o_nine_tails.desc1: Every lash leaves a red welt on the back, on the skin.
item.punizioni.cat_o_nine_tails.desc2: Hurts even more on the whipping post.
item.punizioni.executioner_axe.desc1: Hit whoever is at the block: a hand or a foot comes off.
item.punizioni.executioner_axe.desc2: Right click at the block: choose what to cut.
item.punizioni.executioner_mallet.desc1: Hit whoever is tied to the wheel: one bone at a time.
item.punizioni.executioner_mallet.desc2: The bones stay crooked until death.
item.punizioni.executioner_torch.desc1: Pitch and rags: lights the stake and the fire under the bull.
item.punizioni.executioner_torch.desc2: Flint and steel, torches, fire charges and lava work too.
item.punizioni.whipping_post.desc1: Whoever stands in front gets chained: then the cat-o'-nine-tails.
item.punizioni.iron_maiden.desc1: Whoever goes in does not come out: the doors close on the spikes.
item.punizioni.iron_maiden.desc2: Right click: close. Again, while shut: mercy.
item.punizioni.quartering_rack.desc1: Four black horses pull the arms and legs.
item.punizioni.quartering_rack.desc2: The executioner decides: stop them (stretched body) or let them tear.
item.punizioni.chopping_block.desc1: A hand on the block, then the axe.
item.punizioni.chopping_block.desc2: Hands and feet do not grow back: only death heals.
item.punizioni.rat_table.desc1: Tied to the table, the cage opens.
item.punizioni.rat_table.desc2: Right click: open the cage. Again: call the rats back.
item.punizioni.pyre.desc1: Tied to the post, on the pyre.
item.punizioni.pyre.desc2: Light it with the torch; put it out with a water bucket.
item.punizioni.guillotine.desc1: The lunette on the neck, the blade up high.
item.punizioni.guillotine.desc2: The head drops into the basket (and its owner sees it all).
item.punizioni.wheel.desc1: Tied to the spokes: the mallet breaks the bones.
item.punizioni.wheel.desc2: Then the wheel goes up the post and turns. The crows come.
item.punizioni.brazen_bull.desc1: In through the hatch, the fire underneath.
item.punizioni.brazen_bull.desc2: The screams come out of the nostrils as bellows.
item.punizioni.gallows.desc1: The noose round the neck, the trapdoor under the feet.
item.punizioni.gallows.desc2: Right click: open the trapdoor. Sword or shears: cut the rope.
item.punizioni.royal_crown.desc1: Gold, pearls, rubies, sapphires and emeralds on red velvet.
item.punizioni.royal_crown.desc2: Put it on: a fanfare and an announcement to the whole kingdom.
item.punizioni.royal_cape.desc1: Velvet embroidered in gold, lined with ermine.
item.punizioni.royal_cape.desc2: Real cloth: it sways, billows when you run and trails on the ground.
item.punizioni.royal_lens.desc1: Right click on a subject: inventory, armour and misdeeds.
item.punizioni.royal_lens.desc2: Crouching: their Ender chest. In hand: the guilty glow red.
item.punizioni.overseer_whip.desc1: One crack on the back and the peasant works faster.
item.punizioni.overseer_whip.desc2: 30 seconds of Speed and Haste II. Reaches 5 blocks.
item.punizioni.prisoner_rope.desc1: Right click a player: hands tied, they follow you on the rope.
item.punizioni.prisoner_rope.desc2: Right click a fence: knot them to it. Shears cut the rope.
punizioni.inspect.title: Inspecting %s
punizioni.inspect.pardoned: King %s pardoned you: your misdeeds are forgotten
punizioni.inspect.searched: %s is searching you with the king's lens!
punizioni.inspect.searched.ender: %s is rummaging through your Ender chest!
punizioni.msg.crowned: ♔ %s has been crowned! Long live the king! ♔
punizioni.msg.spurred: %s spurs you on: back to work!
punizioni.bonds.tied_you: %s tied you up: you are their prisoner!
punizioni.bonds.hint: You are tied: only your captor can free you, or someone with shears
punizioni.bonds.cut_you: %s cut your rope: you are free!
punizioni.bonds.knotted_you: You have been knotted to a post
punizioni.bonds.loose: The rope came loose: you are free
punizioni.msg.captured: You are in the executioner's hands
punizioni.msg.nobody_hatch: Nobody in front of the bull's hatch
punizioni.msg.break_hint: Crouch and hit it twice to take it down
punizioni.msg.whip_hint: Chained. Lash with the cat-o'-nine-tails; right click to release
punizioni.msg.horses_ready: Horses ready: right click to whip them away
punizioni.msg.horses_stop_hint: Right click to stop them (stays stretched), or let them pull...
punizioni.msg.chop_hint: On the block: %s. Hit with the axe; right click with the axe to change
punizioni.msg.nothing_to_chop: There is nothing left to cut
punizioni.msg.rats_hint: Tied. Right click: open the cage (crouching: release)
punizioni.msg.pyre_hint: Tied to the stake. Light it with the torch (crouching: release)
punizioni.msg.guillotine_hint: The lunette is shut. Right click: drop the blade (crouching: release)
punizioni.msg.wheel_hint: Tied to the wheel. Break the bones with the mallet, then right click: raise the wheel
punizioni.msg.wheel_raise: Every bone broken: right click to raise the wheel
punizioni.msg.bull_hint: Shut in the bull. Light the fire with the torch (crouching: release)
punizioni.msg.gallows_hint: The noose is on. Right click: open the trapdoor (crouching: release)
punizioni.command.no_machine: No free machine nearby: place a %s
punizioni.command.unknown_bone: Unknown bone: %s (braccio_destro, braccio_sinistro, gamba_destra, gamba_sinistra, tutte)
death.attack.punizioni.maiden: %1$s was pierced inside the iron maiden
death.attack.punizioni.maiden.player: %1$s was shut in the iron maiden by %2$s
death.attack.punizioni.chop.player: %1$s died on the block at the hands of %2$s
death.attack.punizioni.rats.player: %1$s was fed to the rats by %2$s
death.attack.punizioni.wheel.player: %1$s was broken on the wheel by %2$s
death.attack.punizioni.bull: %1$s bellowed one last time inside the brazen bull
death.attack.punizioni.bull.player: %1$s was roasted in the brazen bull by %2$s
death.attack.punizioni.crows: %1$s was pecked to death by crows
death.attack.punizioni.crows.player: %1$s was left to the crows by %2$s
item.punizioni.jester_hat.desc1: Three red and yellow points, a gold bell on each.
item.punizioni.jester_hat.desc2: The points flop at every step, jump and turn.
item.punizioni.jester_tunic.desc1: Quartered red and yellow, a dagged collar with bells.
item.punizioni.jester_tunic.desc2: You hear the jester coming: the bells ring at every step.
item.punizioni.jester_hose.desc1: One yellow leg and one red, gold garters.
item.punizioni.jester_shoes.desc1: Curled toes, a bell on each tip.
item.punizioni.jester_shoes.desc2: The bells bob as you walk.
item.punizioni.peasant_hood.desc1: Rough, frayed jute, with a long tail.
item.punizioni.peasant_tunic.desc1: Patched sackcloth, a rope for a belt, hanging rags.
item.punizioni.peasant_tunic.desc2: With rusty manacles on the wrists and broken chains.
item.punizioni.peasant_breeches.desc1: Torn below the knee, a patch on one knee.
item.punizioni.peasant_wraps.desc1: Rags tied round the feet, irons on the ankles.
item.punizioni.peasant_wraps.desc2: A bit of chain hangs and swings.
item.punizioni.pillory.desc1: Whoever stands behind the board gets locked in: head and hands out.
item.punizioni.pillory.desc2: Right click: lock / open. The bell calls the village.
item.punizioni.poop.desc1: Right click: throw it. It stains whoever it hits, right where it hits.
item.punizioni.poop.desc2: Cows, pigs, sheep, goats and horses drop it now and then. Water washes it off.
punizioni.msg.pillory_hint: In the pillory! Right click it: let go. With dung in hand you throw it.
punizioni.msg.pillory_call: %s is in the pillory! Throw dung at them!
punizioni.msg.washed: You washed: no more dung on you
item.punizioni.roast_pig.desc1: A whole pig on its platter, an apple in its mouth: set it on the table.
item.punizioni.roast_pig.desc2: Right click: tear off the piece you look at. It empties down to the bones.
item.punizioni.gruel_pot.desc1: It bubbles on the fire: right click with an empty bowl to fill it.
item.punizioni.gruel_pot.desc2: Fill it up with a water bucket and scraps (rotten flesh, bones, potatoes...).
item.punizioni.gruel.desc1: Right click a player: they eat it. Or eat it yourself.
item.punizioni.gruel.desc2: Fills a little and tastes awful: a grimace, a burp, sometimes nausea.
punizioni.msg.pot_empty: The pot is empty: add water and scraps
punizioni.msg.prop_break_hint: Crouch and hit twice to take it away
